subject: WonderCon follow-up: inference priorities & next steps
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: WonderCon follow-up: inference priorities & next steps

Hi Elena —

Great meeting you at WonderCon yesterday — thanks for taking time to walk through ClearSight's realtime moderation pipeline. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our call: 

- Key requirements I noted:
  • Volume: ~10k inference requests/day with burst to 50k/day
  • P95 latency target: ~150ms for the scoring endpoint
  • Data residency: EU for training artifacts, processing can be US-hosted for now
  • Security: SOC 2 + audit log retention for 12 months
  • Integration: existing Kafka ingestion and sidecar scoring pattern

- Proposed pilot (4 weeks):
  • Dedicated pool (2x A100 equiv) with autoscaling for burst traffic
  • Prefix/KV caching enabled for common users to reduce per-token cost
  • Eval set run on sample traffic and SLA targets tracked in Redwood Console

Attached is a concise pilot proposal and SOC2 summary — gives a ballpark for costs and timeline. If this aligns, next steps I suggest:

1) Quick security sync (30m) to confirm data handling and any PO requirements
2) Pilot kickoff with a 4-week scope and success criteria (latency & cost targets)
3) Pricing/contract overview with Marissa + Ben (we can put together an MSA + SOW)

Here are two slots on my calendar: https://calendly.com/redwood/tessa-demo. Happy to flex if those don't work. 

If you'd like, I can loop in our CS lead (Ben) and our pricing lead (Marissa) on the next note — I think a short triage call will get us to a pilot POC quickly.

Thanks again — enjoyed the demo and excited to explore a pilot with ClearSight.

— Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
T: (415) 555-0123 | tessa.morgan@redwood.ai
Attachment: Redwood-Pilot-Proposal-Clearsight.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB)
Attachment: SOC2-Summary.pdf (PDF, 450 KB)

From: Elena Rossi <elena@clearsight.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: WonderCon follow-up: inference priorities & next steps

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the clear recap and the proposal. A couple quick questions from our side before we lock in a call:

1) Pricing: can you share a small-scale pricing example for starting with a single A100-equivalent node for a short pilot? We want to understand OPEX if we start smaller and ramp.
2) On-prem / data residency: you mentioned EU residency for training artifacts but processing in US. For some customers we need full EU processing — is a private/VPC on-prem option available within the pilot timeline?
3) References: do you have a customer that uses Redwood for realtime moderation (similar latency profile) we can speak to?

If we can get quick answers to the above, I can pull Marcus (infrastructure) and SalesOps in to coordinate procurement.

Best,
Elena
Elena Rossi
Head of Product, ClearSight AI
elena@clearsight.ai

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rossi <elena@clearsight.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 02 May 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: WonderCon follow-up: inference priorities & next steps

Hi Elena —

Just bumping this in case it slipped through — quick answers inline below and happy to schedule a short call: 

1) Pricing (small pilot): starting configuration with a single A100-equivalent node + network costs typically lands in the $6k–9k / month range for test/POC capacity; pilot accounting with short-term credits brings effective cost lower for the initial 4-week run. We can put a concrete example in an SOW.

2) Residency / Private options: yes — Redwood Private supports VPC-hosted deployments and on-prem packaging; we can scope an EU-only processing environment but that requires coordination for infra and slightly longer lead time (2–3 weeks) depending on region. For immediate value, many customers start with EU-trained artifacts and US-hosted inference then transition to Private for full EU residency.

3) References: happy to introduce you to a customer using Redwood for moderation (private intro). I can arrange a 20m call next week.

If this looks ok, would love to get the security sync on the calendar — here are my open slots: https://calendly.com/redwood/tessa-demo. Otherwise I can hand to Marissa/Ben to align on contracting/pricing.

— Tessa
Attachment: Redwood-Pilot-Proposal-Clearsight.pdf (PDF, 1.2 MB)
